name: beacon
description: Desktop notifications when a session needs you (permission prompt, question, long turn done), plus a status file per session for the tower to read.

remoteAnswers.title: Answer from the tower
remoteAnswers.description: Which sessions send their permission prompts and questions to the tower instead of the terminal: launched (sessions the tower started), always, or never.

notifyOnDone.title: Notify when a turn finishes
notifyOnDone.description: Send a notification when a main-loop turn ends after running at least minTurnSeconds.

minTurnSeconds.title: Minimum turn length (seconds)
minTurnSeconds.description: Shorter turns finish without a notification.

notifyOnIdle.title: Notify on idle reminders
notifyOnIdle.description: Also notify when Claude Code reminds you the session is waiting for input.
